questions.purpose: Plain sufficiency: three relevant pages on two hosts, one off-topic page. Measures source quality, completeness and the stop rule.
questions.question: What is the Corvane plugin loader and how does it isolate plugins?

pages.title: Corvane plugin loader primer
paragraphs: The Corvane plugin loader is an open plugin framework for desktop applications written in Java. It discovers plugins in a directory and starts them in a defined order.
Corvane isolates every plugin in its own class loader. Classes of the plugin are loaded plugin-first, so two plugins can bundle different versions of the same library.
The project was started in 2019 and is maintained by a small group of volunteers.

pages.title: Independent review of the Corvane plugin loader
paragraphs: In our review the Corvane plugin loader handled forty plugins without conflicts. Plugin-first class loading kept the bundled library versions apart.
Startup took 1.8 seconds for forty plugins on a laptop, which the reviewers found acceptable for a desktop application.

pages.title: Corvane plugin loader in production
paragraphs: Three desktop vendors run the Corvane plugin loader in production. They report that the isolation by class loader prevented dependency clashes after updates.
One vendor ships 120 plugins with Corvane and updates them independently of the host application.

pages.title: Corvane garden loader, 40 litre bucket
paragraphs: The Corvane garden loader is a 40 litre plastic bucket with a reinforced handle. It fits most wheelbarrows.
Available in green and grey. Free delivery from two buckets.

questions.purpose: Contradiction detection: the manufacturer and an independent test state different battery capacities.
questions.question: What battery capacity does the Kestrel-7 field tablet have?

pages.title: Kestrel-7 field tablet specifications
paragraphs: The Kestrel-7 field tablet has a battery capacity of 4,200 mAh and runs for up to eleven hours of mapping work.
The Kestrel-7 field tablet charges over USB-C with 18 watts and reaches eighty percent in ninety minutes.

pages.title: Lab test: Kestrel-7 field tablet battery
paragraphs: We opened the Kestrel-7 field tablet and measured the battery cell. The printed and measured battery capacity is 3,800 mAh.
In our mapping workload the Kestrel-7 field tablet ran for nine hours and twenty minutes.

pages.title: Kestrel-7 field tablet runtime reports from users
paragraphs: Users of the Kestrel-7 field tablet report between nine and ten hours of runtime during survey work.
Several users charge the Kestrel-7 field tablet in the car with a USB-C adapter.

pages.title: The common kestrel
paragraphs: The common kestrel is a small falcon that hovers above fields while hunting voles.
A kestrel weighs between 150 and 300 grams.

questions.purpose: Gap detection: the outline asks for the environmental impact, no page covers it.
questions.question: What does the renovation of the Harbor Lane bridge in Ostmarsh cost, how long does it take and what is its environmental impact?

pages.title: Harbor Lane bridge renovation, Ostmarsh town council
paragraphs: The Ostmarsh town council approved the renovation of the Harbor Lane bridge with a budget of 14.6 million euros.
Work on the Harbor Lane bridge starts in March and is planned to last 22 months, with one lane open at all times.

pages.title: Harbor Lane bridge: what drivers in Ostmarsh must know
paragraphs: The renovation of the Harbor Lane bridge in Ostmarsh will cost 14.6 million euros according to the council.
Drivers should expect a single open lane on the Harbor Lane bridge for 22 months.

pages.title: Contractor chosen for the Harbor Lane bridge in Ostmarsh
paragraphs: A regional construction firm won the Harbor Lane bridge contract in Ostmarsh. The bridge deck and the railings will be replaced.
The firm will work in two phases so that the Harbor Lane bridge stays passable.

questions.question: How corrosion resistant is Lindqvist alloy in sea water?

pages.title: Lindqvist alloy datasheet
paragraphs: Lindqvist alloy is a copper nickel alloy with 2.5 percent tin. In sea water Lindqvist alloy loses 0.02 millimetres per year to corrosion.
Lindqvist alloy is used for propeller shafts and sea water valves.

pages.title: Corrosion of Lindqvist alloy in North Sea water: a two-year study
paragraphs: Coupons of Lindqvist alloy were exposed to North Sea water for two years. The corrosion rate stayed below 0.03 millimetres per year.
Pitting was not observed on Lindqvist alloy, unlike on the stainless steel reference samples.

pages.title: Field notes: Lindqvist alloy sea water valves after five years
paragraphs: Ship engineers removed Lindqvist alloy sea water valves after five years of service and found only light surface corrosion.
The valves were reinstalled without machining.

pages.title: The Lindqvist family of Gothenburg
paragraphs: The Lindqvist family were merchants in Gothenburg from 1780. Their ships traded salt and sea water fish.
A family alloy of silver cutlery is kept in the town museum.

pages.title: Lindqvist Alloy, a metal band from Malmo
paragraphs: Lindqvist Alloy is a metal band from Malmo. Their second album Corrosion was recorded by the sea.
The band tours Scandinavia every winter.
